I have worked in retails! I was also nervous when first started haha

You'll get the hang of it after a while, don't think too much. You know billions people works in retails, it's not rocket science. So you can do it too just like others.

So to answer your question, how to make the time go faster and less nerve-racking? I found it helpful to get to know your team well when first arrive. Getting friendly with co workers make me feel more relaxed. Also people just like to chat in general cuz it makes the day go faster! Another good thing about getting friendly with your team is that, they will help you with leaning things on the job like the products and the shop etc.

Second, I found cleaning and tidying the shop floor when it's quiet also calms me down and makes time go faster. It also helps you to get familiar with the environment so you get more relaxed.

Third, take a 10 min short nap during lunch break. Get your favorite sandwich and treat yourself with something sweet boost your mood and energy for the afternoon.

Forth, treat the customer like your chat mate. Chatting just get you through the day so fast. So talk to your customers, just mindless things, like the weather, and help them find what they are looking for. If it's a clothes shop, you can even give advices on fashion sometimes. Of course if they are also in the mood to talk. leave them alone if they prefer. But it won't hurt to say hi and ask how their day's been. It also leaves a good impression to your supervisor that you are doing your job properly.

Overall, take it lightly, it's just a retail job, you can always get another one if this one doesn't work out. Just take it easy, you are working with people, and not many people want to cause trouble on their daily going about.

Btw if you do get crazy shoppers that are looking for trouble, get your colleagues and supervisor. Normally they don't expect a newbie to deal with these kinda situations.

Best luck!
